description: This file contains the implementation of a singly linked list data structure with methods for adding, removing, retrieving size, and getting elements by index. It also includes an internal Node class and a companion object with a utility method.

classes.name: LinkedList
classes.description: A class representing a singly linked list with basic operations like add, remove, size, and get.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: An internal class representing a node in the linked list, containing data and a reference to the next node.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new element to the end of the linked list.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the first occurrence of the specified element from the list.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the list.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the element at the specified index.

methods.name: unlink
methods.description: Removes a node from the list by updating references.

methods.name: tail
methods.description: Returns the last node in the list starting from the head.
